statement:
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category.
Let $0 \to (A, d) \to (B, d) \to (C, d) \to 0$ be a short exact sequence
of differential objects. Then we get an exact homology sequence
$$
\ldots \to H(C, d) \to H(A, d) \to H(B, d) \to H(C, d) \to \ldots
$$
hypotheses: Let $0\to(A,d)\to(B,d)\to(C,d)\to0$ be short exact in the category of differential objects of an abelian category.
conclusions: The indicated periodic long exact homology sequence among $H(A,d),H(B,d),H(C,d)$ exists.
original_source_statement_tex:
\label{lemma-differential-objects-ses}
Let $\mathcal{A}$ be an abelian category.
Let $0 \to (A, d) \to (B, d) \to (C, d) \to 0$ be a short exact sequence
of differential objects. Then we get an exact homology sequence
$$
\ldots \to H(C, d) \to H(A, d) \to H(B, d) \to H(C, d) \to \ldots
$$
